paragraphs: R' Abba bar Zemina — Berakhot, end of chapter 6.
Rabbi Yosi bar Zemina — Kilayim, beginning of chapter 5.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Guggenheimer Berakhot 6:8 section, three whole paragraphs, is a bounded nonmatch for Abba bar Zemina; it is not absence elsewhere or a repair of Hyman’s end-of-chapter locator. That uncollated title remains R'. The complete seven-paragraph Kilayim 5:1 section explicitly names Rabbi Yose bar Zemina, supporting that second full title. The pointers remain separate without a common-father inference.
